messages:
Maya (AE): ACME POC: streaming from inside corp network failing. Can SE help triage?

Sam (Customer Eng): Repro: Node 18 + TS SDK and Python httpx both drop after ~10s when routed via corp proxy. App logs show 'socket hang up' and proxy logs show TLS alert 'unexpected_message'. Outside corp network streams fine.

Priya (SE): quick checks: are HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY set? HTTP/2 vs HTTP/1.1? Any PAC?

Sam (Customer Eng): They use PAC and an outbound forward proxy. TS: http2 streaming. Python: h2 via httpx. Both fail behind the proxy.

Alec (Eng): likely middlebox/TLS MITM or long-lived h2 not tolerated. Short-term tests: force HTTP/1.1 chunked, enable aggressive TCP keepalive, and reduce TLS session resume features. Also capture pcap.

Devon (Infra): request minimal repro and CURL command to run through their proxy. Example: curl -v --http2 --proxy http://proxy:8080 -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/stream" --data-binary @payload.bin. Run NODE_DEBUG=http2,tls for node.

Maya (AE): customer asks if Dedicated/private avoids this? Also wants pricing delta and onboarding time.

Priya (SE): yes Dedicated (VPC) avoids corp proxy if egress is customer-managed. Typical onboarding 3-6 weeks; I'll send pricing baseline.

Alec (Eng): I'll provide Node+Python samples by EOD with toggles: preferHttp1, socketKeepAliveMs, maxWriteChunkBytes, debugDisableSessionTickets, requestTimeoutMs, maxRetries. Will also include a curl+pktcap helper.

Sam (Customer Eng): I'll run samples and upload pcap. Note: they saw transient 429s when retries occur, so include backoff+jitter.

poc-bot: created POC-4799, assigned to Priya and Alec.

Maya (AE): Action items: Sam run tests/upload pcap; Alec/Priya samples EOD; Maya share Dedicated doc/pricing.

Sam (Customer Eng): ack, will update within 24h.
